endorsements.name: Georgios Gkitsas
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-7664
endorsements.description: In all versions of the package github.com/unknwon/cae/zip, the ExtractTo function doesn't securely escape file paths in zip archives which include leading or non-leading "..". This allows an attacker to add or replace files system-wide.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
